<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr) where a halide (leaving group) is replaced by an amine nucleophile on an aromatic ring. This means the forward reaction breaks a carbon‑halogen bond (halide functional group) and forms a carbon‑nitrogen bond (amine functional group). We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a halide and form an amine.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)Cl", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
